verdictScope: Current frozen FIG23 only; independent source-compatible semantics and actual 640px/331px offline preview inspection.
summary: All three source apparatus subparts, bellows/frame/rod/top plate relationships, gauge connections and essential needle directions, and bath/thermometer placements are preserved. Modern state labels correctly express the frozen FIG23 text without inventing instrument values. Twelve aliases bind existing exact centers and do not create a separate visible instructional state. No essential source contradiction or actual preview clipping/occlusion/incoherent overlap was found.

sourceFirst.sequence: Input-freeze -> original PNG open 1 -> own source-first inventory saved -> project/skill instructions -> current640 open 2 -> current331 open 3 -> actual Spec/SVG and frozen diagnostics -> independent findings/report.

semanticReview.coverage: Every real original subpart is covered in independent-findings.json, with exact current object and relationship IDs.
semanticReview.mechanics: Frames contain their bellows; vertical rods meet the moving top plates. Each hose joins its own right apparatus outlet to its separate gauge. B is expanded relative to a; c is compressed relative to b, using local bellows heights rather than raw cross-panel displacement.
semanticReview.needles: A and b long needles point upper right; c points lower right. Counter-tails are opposite. Actual SVG endpoints match the current Spec.
semanticReview.thermalArrangement: A is unbathed with a separate slanted thermometer; b/c have surrounding baths on supporting blocks, with left-side thermometers in the bath and outside the bellows gas volume.
semanticReview.labels: English a/b/c and a:(p1,V1,T1), b:(p1,V-prime,T2), c:(p2,V2,T2) are modern text-derived additions. They are not measured source-pixel values.
semanticReview.noninventedCalibration: No numeric gauge or thermometer reading, unit, calibrated scale or measured volume ratio is claimed. Schematic dial/ruler ticks and corrugations are disclosed regularization.

specSvgInspection.independentMethod: Read-only JSON comparison and XML inspection, plus original/current visual observations. This is not a replay of the native validator, renderer or collision stage.
specSvgInspection.labelRepair: Only three V-label placements differ among text objects; all visible label strings and authoritativeText remain unchanged.
specSvgInspection.aliases: Every new point equals its original circle center exactly; circle references resolve to those same coordinates. Actual SVG markers have outer radius 2.05 inside existing same-center opaque radius-3 disks, with no new label or color.
specSvgInspection.pointRelationships: All four required inventory groups cover every mapped point with a mapped multipoint relationship wholly within the group. Their declared displacements match resolved drawing-space coordinates.

offlineVisualReview.requiredPreviews: Actual current frozen PNGs, not imagined from code and not rerendered.
offlineVisualReview.fullPreviewReason: 640px and 331px views resolve the requested visual questions; optional full file was hash-verified only.
